description: A travel-walk segment tick: DM narrates the terrain passing, no dice fabricated, ends on an open sensory hook.

turn.action: I keep walking the coast road toward the stilt-village.

response.narration: The road bends inland around a stand of dead pines, salt-killed and silver. Somewhere off to your left the marsh clicks and settles the way wet things do at low tide. Ahead, the stilts of Eel-Fishers' Village start to show through the haze, thin as insect legs.
